message.content:
Here’s a mix of classics, modern hits, and hidden gems you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** (1980) | A psychological masterpiece with iconic imagery and unsettling atmosphere. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** (2018) | Intense dread, strong performances, and a truly original story. |
| 3 | **Get Out** (2017) | Social satire meets genuine terror; clever twists keep you guessing. |
| 4 | **Midsommar** (2019) | Bright daylight horror—unsettling rituals set against a pastoral backdrop. |
| 5 | **It Follows** (2014) | Simple premise but delivers relentless tension and creepy visuals. |
| 6 | **A Quiet Place** (2018) | Silence is survival; the sound design makes every noise feel deadly. |
| 7 | **The Babadook** (2014) | Psychological depth, haunting score, and a metaphorical take on grief. |
| 8 | **The Conjuring** (2013) | Strong pacing, effective scares, and a solid foundation for its universe. |
| 9 | **Suspiria** (1977) | Visually striking, eerie soundtrack, and an unforgettable ending. |
|10 | **The Witch** (2015) | Slow burn, period authenticity, and a chilling sense of isolation. |

Feel free to pick based on your mood—whether you want classic dread or something fresh and inventive!
